title: WiSP: A Working-Set View of Mixture-of-Experts Serving on Extremely Low-Resource Hardware
abstract: arXiv:2606.21868v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern local and agentic workloads often need large-model capacity at low concurrency, but run on GPUs that cannot keep a frontier-scale model resident. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are a natural fit because they activate only a small subset of experts per token, but their sparsity saves computation, not residency: the full expert pool still has to be stored, and any expert used by a layer must be in GPU memory when that layer runs. Static layer-level CPU offload makes such models fit, but transfers the expert layer in bulk on every forward pass, losing much of the sparsity advantage. We view low-resource MoE serving as a working-set problem on the GPU. Routed expert weights and the KV cache are two memory-demand streams competing for the same limited VRAM. We implement this view in WiSP (Working-Set Paging), a routing-aware expert pager that plugs into an unmodified serving engine and preserves byte-identical outputs. On a real 2

translated_title: WiSP：在极低资源硬件上服务混合专家模型的工作集视角
translated_abstract: 现代本地和智能体工作负载通常需要在低并发场景下获得大模型能力，但所运行的GPU无法将前沿规模的模型完整驻留在显存中。混合专家模型是自然的选择，因为每个token只激活一小部分专家，但其稀疏性节省的是计算量而非驻留空间：完整的专家池仍需存储，且某一层所用的任何专家在该层运行时必须位于GPU内存中。静态的层级CPU卸载虽然能让这类模型装得下，但每次前向传播都要批量传输整个专家层，损失了大部分稀疏性优势。我们将低资源MoE服务视为GPU上的工作集问题：路由专家权重和KV缓存是两个争夺同一有限显存的内存需求流。我们在WiSP（工作集分页）中实现了这一视角，它是一个路由感知的专家分页器，可插入未经修改的服务引擎并保持字节级一致的输出。在一个真实的2……
tldr: 提出WiSP系统，将极低资源GPU上的MoE推理建模为工作集问题，通过路由感知的专家分页器在专家权重与KV缓存之间动态调度有限显存，在不修改服务引擎且保证输出字节级一致的前提下实现大模型高效本地服务。
en_tdlr: WiSP reframes MoE serving on extremely low-resource GPUs as a working-set problem, using a routing-aware expert pager to arbitrate limited VRAM between expert weights and the KV cache, enabling efficient inference with byte-identical outputs and no engine modifications.
